CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2833 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head ddb4398a15abe3d445a959d922c1dc9b7f685831. Bus nonce: cb63cf3951d36d160fa79909cf56ef59. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin ddb4398a15abe3d445a959d922c1dc9b7f685831`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge ddb4398a15abe3d445a959d922c1dc9b7f685831` or `Fix review: blocked ddb4398a15abe3d445a959d922c1dc9b7f685831 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: cb63cf3951d36d160fa79909cf56ef59`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `ddb4398a15abe3d445a959d922c1dc9b7f685831` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2833 ddb4398a15abe3d445a959d922c1dc9b7f685831") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2833-cb63cf39`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
DELTA REVIEW of #2833 (R10-PLAN-ISSUES-CHART), round 2, head ddb4398a15abe3d445a959d922c1dc9b7f685831. Your round-1 verdict, the blocked "Fix review" comment on this PR, was blocked on two items. Scope this review to those two items plus the code change since the round-1 head, and nothing else. Review per dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md (origin/main) from a detached worktree at the head SHA.

Item 1, the harness depth seam: dev/audit/harnesses/r10_plan_issues_chart_mutants.py used a parents[3] walk to find the repository root. At the round-2 head it takes its root from the shared repo_root helper imported from r10_plan_page_mutants. Verify the root resolves to the repository root from the harness's real location, that the driver still runs end to end at the head, and that its mutant results at the head are the ones the body reports. Mutate the root resolution (for example a wrong parents depth) and confirm the driver fails rather than silently passing.

Item 2, the pr-contract Red-checks omission: the pull-request body's "## Red checks" section must answer every red check named on the head. Check the body against the check-runs API at ddb4398a and report whether each red or failed check on this head is answered there, and whether the section's form is what checkPrBody requires.

The code diff since the round-1 head: take the head that the round-1 verdict measured (its first line names it) and diff it against this round-2 head. That range also carries files merged in from origin/main (tools/policy/agreement.mjs, dev/programme/delivery/2697.md and 2820.md, the merge-subject harnesses, tests/closures.json lines of other PRs). Those are not this PR's changes. Judge the PR's own files: the three-dot diff against origin/main is the authority (`git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)...HEAD`), and read the rest of the round-2 delta only inside it. Re-run the plan-page self-test and the issues-chart mutant driver at the head and report the figures you measured, not the body's. Check the null controls still hold: an empty or all-closed issue set, every carrier unplanned, and an offline snapshot.

Check that the delivery row dev/programme/delivery/2833.md is in the three-dot diff. Check that the merge with origin/main is clean (`git merge-tree --write-tree`), and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.

Output: write verdict.md in a fresh directory of your own, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge ddb4398a15abe3d445a959d922c1dc9b7f685831` or `Fix review: blocked ddb4398a15abe3d445a959d922c1dc9b7f685831`, then the bus nonce line `bus-nonce: cb63cf3951d36d160fa79909cf56ef59`, then your findings with a severity and a carry for each. Post the verdict as a comment on PR #2833. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce. Do not name any path under a home directory in the verdict.
